roof-coffee.rationale: Garden-fresh rooftop-sunrise ritual: a rising sun wash and slow drifting clouds evoke 'closer to the sky with a cup'.

razeen-coffee.rationale: Majlis-heritage calm: warm lantern glow, a top/bottom sadu shimmer band and slow rising steam make time slow down in the guest's chest.

qawam.rationale: Editorial-mag measured craft: fine ruled lines gliding like a barista's notebook plus a slow ink bleed — everything weighed, nothing loud.

cafe-n.rationale: Neon-arcade midnight wink: a faint arcade grid, a sweeping scanline, pulsing neon glows and blinking sparks say 'the night just started'.

public-cafe.rationale: Ticket-diner corner for everyone: a gently drifting checkerboard-tile floor and warm diner haze in the margins feel like the neighborhood's own table.

rewanted-cafe.rationale: Berry-pink neon twinkle sells the late-night dessert escape without shouting.

salam-coffee.rationale: Poster-dark 'peace after dark' courtyard: a soft breathing accent halo, gently twinkling stars, and a calming vignette that settles the night around legible text.

matal-al-wadi.rationale: Majlis-heritage valley farmhouse: a flickering warm lantern halo in the corner, drifting leaves for the wadi, and a faint sadu-weave band along the floor evoke family gathering and heritage pride.

rakiyah-roastery.rationale: Editorial-mag traveler's journal: minimal ruled lines drift across the page like margins, a slow ink blot floats and a slowly rotating compass ring hints at chasing coffee lands.

marthad-coffee.rationale: Ticket-diner late-shift counter: a warm diner haze rising from the base, wisps of steam climbing off the machine, and a ticking order-rail down the edge capture the awake-all-night counter energy.

haffa-coffee-roaster.rationale: Neon-arcade roasting edge: a pulsing accent heat-glow rising from the base, embers/sparks flying up off the roaster, and a faint arcade grid express standing at the glowing edge of the fire.

kazar-cafe.rationale: Poster-dark midnight espresso stage: a theatrical spotlight sweeps a dark house while steam rises and embers float — coffee performing on stage.

yellow-rose.rationale: Poster-dark drama: a swaying stage spotlight, a soft vignette, and leaves drifting down evoke 'a rose garden that stays up late'.

noma-coffee.rationale: Neon-arcade lab: a center-masked glowing grid, a sweeping scanline, an under-glow and twinkling stars say 'a coffee lab glowing after midnight'.

lihaf.rationale: Storybook-light quilt world: soft warm clouds drift in the margins and paper motes float up like a slow Tuwaiq morning, center kept airy so text reads.

serb-coffee.rationale: Poster-dark flock world: a slow cinematic light-sweep, twinkling stars and a small V-chevron flock migrating across the top margin sell the long night sky.

mat-cookies.rationale: Neon-arcade sugar world: a glowing perspective grid floor scrolls, a scanline sweeps and neon sparks pulse at the edges for after-midnight arcade energy, center dim for legibility.
mat-cookies.css: .brandbg{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:0;pointer-events:none;overflow:hidden;background:radial-gradient(100% 80% at 50% 120%,color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 20%,transparent),transparent 60%),linear-gradient(180deg,var(--bg-0),var(--bg-1))}.brandbg .grid{position:absolute;left:-10%;right:-10%;bottom:-5%;height:45%;background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,transparent 0 46px,color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 30%,transparent) 46px 48px),repeating-linear-gradient(0deg,transparent 0 40px,color-mix(in srgb,var(--sa) 26%,transparent) 40px 42px);transform:perspective(40vmax) rotateX(62deg);transform-origin:bottom;opacity:.4;mask:linear-gradient(transparent,#000)}.brandbg .scan{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;height:2px;top:0;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--sa2,var(--sa)) 60%,transparent);opacity:.4;box-shadow:0 0 12px color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 60%,transparent)}.brandbg .sp{position:absolute;width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent);box-shadow:0 0 8px var(--accent);opacity:.7}.brandbg .p1{top:20%;left:18%}.brandbg .p2{top:34%;left:76%}.brandbg .p3{top:58%;left:30%}@media (prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){.brandbg .grid{animation:mcg 8s linear infinite}.brandbg .scan{animation:mcs 6s linear infinite}.brandbg .sp{animation:mcp 3s ease-in-out infinite}.brandbg .p2{animation-delay:.7s}.brandbg .p3{animation-delay:1.4s}@keyframes mcg{to{background-position:0 42px,42px 0}}@keyframes mcs{0%{top:-2%;opacity:0}12%{opacity:.5}88%{opacity:.5}100%{top:102%;opacity:0}}@keyframes mcp{0%,100%{transform:scale(.6);opacity:.2}50%{transform:scale(1.2);opacity:.9}}}

hacked.rationale: Playful-hand notebook world: faint ruled+dotted paper, bouncing wobbly ink blots and a swaying hand-scribble underline capture sweet mischief without touching the text zone.
hacked.css: .brandbg{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:0;pointer-events:none;overflow:hidden;background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--bg-0),var(--bg-1))}.brandbg .rule{position:absolute;inset:0;background:repeating-linear-gradient(0deg,transparent 0 38px,color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 12%,transparent) 38px 39px),radial-gradient(circle,color-mix(in srgb,var(--sa) 16%,transparent) 1.2px,transparent 1.6px) 0 0/26px 26px;opacity:.5}.brandbg .dot{position:absolute;border-radius:50% 48% 52% 50%;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 70%,transparent);opacity:.5}.brandbg .d1{width:22px;height:22px;top:18%;left:14%}.brandbg .d2{width:14px;height:14px;top:64%;left:24%;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent-2) 70%,transparent)}.brandbg .d3{width:18px;height:18px;top:36%;left:82%}.brandbg .d4{width:12px;height:12px;top:76%;left:70%}.brandbg .scr{position:absolute;top:50%;left:60%;width:120px;height:18px;border-bottom:3px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 60%,transparent);border-radius:0 0 60% 40%;opacity:.4}@media (prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){.brandbg .dot{animation:hkb 5s ease-in-out infinite}.brandbg .d2{animation-duration:6.5s;animation-delay:.4s}.brandbg .d3{animation-duration:5.8s;animation-delay:.8s}.brandbg .d4{animation-duration:7s;animation-delay:.2s}.brandbg .scr{animation:hks 9s ease-in-out infinite}@keyframes hkb{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0) rotate(-6deg)}50%{transform:translateY(-14px) rotate(6deg)}}@keyframes hks{0%,100%{transform:rotate(-3deg) scaleX(.96)}50%{transform:rotate(3deg) scaleX(1.04)}}}

secret-pot-bakery.rationale: Ticket-diner oven world: a warm dusk glow rises from the base while soft steam wisps waver and fade upward, the smell-of-fresh-bread promise, staying in the lower margins.
secret-pot-bakery.css: .brandbg{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:0;pointer-events:none;overflow:hidden;background:radial-gradient(90% 70% at 50% 110%,color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 22%,transparent),transparent 60%),linear-gradient(180deg,var(--bg-0),var(--bg-1))}.brandbg .haze{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;height:55%;background:linear-gradient(0deg,color-mix(in srgb,var(--sa) 26%,transparent),transparent);opacity:.5}.brandbg .stm{position:absolute;bottom:8%;width:40px;height:38vmax;border-radius:50%;filter:blur(26px);background:linear-gradient(0deg,color-mix(in srgb,var(--sa) 40%,transparent),transparent 75%);opacity:.4}.brandbg .w1{left:24%}.brandbg .w2{left:52%;opacity:.32}.brandbg .w3{left:74%;opacity:.28}@media (prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){.brandbg .stm{animation:spst 9s ease-in-out infinite}.brandbg .w2{animation-duration:11s;animation-delay:1.2s}.brandbg .w3{animation-duration:8s;animation-delay:.6s}@keyframes spst{0%{transform:translateY(20px) scaleX(1);opacity:0}25%{opacity:.4}75%{opacity:.35}100%{transform:translateY(-30px) scaleX(1.4);opacity:0}}}

the-cake-corner.rationale: Poster-dark velvet spotlight + twinkling star motif frames the after-midnight craving without touching the readable center.

kunafa-abul-haus.rationale: Majlis lantern glow + sadu shimmer band + rising steam wisps evoke a tray fresh off the fire and family pride.

breddy.rationale: Ticket-diner dawn haze + soft drifting clouds + low warm sun capture the neighborhood oven glowing before first light.

chimney-cafe.rationale: Neon-arcade grid pulse + scanlines + rising sparks deliver the electric late-night sugar run under city lights.

croi-bakehouse.rationale: Poster-dark slow ink blooms + a single editorial rule breathing over a low oven glow express the baker's calm heart.

lyrs-bakery.rationale: The bakehouse that never sleeps: warm oven-glow rising from the base with drifting steam wisps — ticket-diner haze, not a rave.
lyrs-bakery.css: .brandbg{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:0;pointer-events:none;overflow:hidden;background:radial-gradient(120% 80% at 50% 120%,var(--accent) 0%,transparent 45%)}.brandbg .haze{position:absolute;inset:-10%;background:radial-gradient(40% 50% at 20% 90%,var(--sa) 0%,transparent 60%),radial-gradient(40% 50% at 85% 85%,var(--accent-2) 0%,transparent 60%);opacity:.14;filter:blur(30px)}.brandbg .steam{position:absolute;bottom:-15%;width:8px;height:60vh;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(to top,var(--sa),transparent);opacity:.10;filter:blur(9px)}.brandbg .s1{left:12%}.brandbg .s2{left:38%}.brandbg .s3{left:66%}.brandbg .s4{left:88%}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){.brandbg .steam{animation:rise 9s ease-in-out infinite}.brandbg .s2{animation-delay:2s}.brandbg .s3{animation-delay:4s}.brandbg .s4{animation-delay:1s}@keyframes rise{0%{transform:translateY(20%) scaleX(1);opacity:0}30%{opacity:.12}100%{transform:translateY(-40%) scaleX(2.4);opacity:0}}}

sip-day-specialty-coffee.rationale: A day measured in sips: two lantern glows breathe at the top edges over a faint drifting sadu/tile weave — majlis warmth, unhurried.
sip-day-specialty-coffee.css: .brandbg{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:0;pointer-events:none;overflow:hidden;background:radial-gradient(100% 70% at 50% 0%,var(--accent) 0%,transparent 50%)}.brandbg .lantern{position:absolute;top:-8%;width:34vw;height:34vw;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,var(--sa) 0%,transparent 65%);opacity:.14;filter:blur(24px)}.brandbg .l1{left:-6%}.brandbg .l2{right:-6%;background:radial-gradient(circle,var(--accent-2) 0%,transparent 65%)}.brandbg .sadu{position:absolute;inset:0;opacity:.06;background:repeating-linear-gradient(45deg,var(--accent) 0 10px,transparent 10px 22px),repeating-linear-gradient(-45deg,var(--sa2) 0 10px,transparent 10px 22px);-webkit-mask:linear-gradient(to bottom,#000,transparent 32%,transparent 68%,#000);mask:linear-gradient(to bottom,#000,transparent 32%,transparent 68%,#000)}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){.brandbg .lantern{animation:glow 7s ease-in-out infinite}.brandbg .l2{animation-delay:3.5s}.brandbg .sadu{animation:shim 12s linear infinite}@keyframes glow{0%,100%{opacity:.10;transform:scale(1)}50%{opacity:.20;transform:scale(1.08)}}@keyframes shim{to{background-position:44px 0,-44px 0}}}

nafas-cafe.rationale: Take a breath, you're among family: soft clouds drift slowly at the margins with gently floating motes — storybook light, breathing room.

matchafulll.rationale: An electric green glow after dark: a rolling perspective grid, a pulsing halo and faint scanlines — neon-arcade charge kept low-opacity so text stays clean.
matchafulll.css: .brandbg{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:0;pointer-events:none;overflow:hidden;background:radial-gradient(120% 90% at 50% 50%,transparent 30%,var(--bg-1) 100%)}.brandbg .grid{position:absolute;inset:-20%;background:linear-gradient(var(--accent) 1px,transparent 1px) 0 0/100% 46px,linear-gradient(90deg,var(--accent) 1px,transparent 1px) 0 0/46px 100%;opacity:.08;transform:perspective(400px) rotateX(60deg);transform-origin:bottom}.brandbg .scan{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(var(--sa),transparent 6px);background-size:100% 5px;opacity:.05}.brandbg .halo{position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(50% 40% at 50% 40%,var(--accent) 0%,transparent 60%);opacity:.10;filter:blur(20px)}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){.brandbg .grid{animation:roll 8s linear infinite}.brandbg .halo{animation:pls 4s ease-in-out infinite}.brandbg .scan{animation:swp 6s linear infinite}@keyframes roll{to{background-position:0 46px,0 0}}@keyframes pls{0%,100%{opacity:.07}50%{opacity:.18}}@keyframes swp{to{background-position:0 5px}}}

the-sweet-sip.rationale: A velvet evening made for dessert: a slow cinematic spotlight sweeps a deep-night stage while stars twinkle — poster-dark drama, edges only.
the-sweet-sip.css: .brandbg{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:0;pointer-events:none;overflow:hidden;background:radial-gradient(140% 100% at 50% -20%,var(--bg-1) 0%,var(--bg-0) 70%)}.brandbg .spot{position:absolute;top:-30%;left:20%;width:60vw;height:120vh;background:linear-gradient(var(--accent),transparent 70%);opacity:.10;filter:blur(30px);transform:rotate(18deg);transform-origin:top}.brandbg .star{position:absolute;width:4px;height:4px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--sa);box-shadow:0 0 6px var(--sa);opacity:.5}.brandbg .t1{top:18%;left:14%}.brandbg .t2{top:30%;right:20%}.brandbg .t3{top:62%;left:24%}.brandbg .t4{top:74%;right:16%}.brandbg .t5{top:44%;left:80%}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){.brandbg .spot{animation:swp 12s ease-in-out infinite}.brandbg .star{animation:tw 3.5s ease-in-out infinite}.brandbg .t2{animation-delay:.8s}.brandbg .t3{animation-delay:1.6s}.brandbg .t4{animation-delay:2.4s}.brandbg .t5{animation-delay:1.1s}@keyframes swp{0%,100%{transform:rotate(12deg)}50%{transform:rotate(24deg);opacity:.16}}@keyframes tw{0%,100%{opacity:.2;transform:scale(.8)}50%{opacity:.7;transform:scale(1.2)}}}

harf-cafe.rationale: Editorial ink world: drifting ruled lines + soft ink washes evoke a calligrapher composing a cup letter by letter.

caia-coffee.rationale: Poster-dark window seat: a slow cinematic spotlight sweep, low ember glow and distant twinkling stars for the quiet, awake city night.

shanab-cafe.rationale: Playful-hand family world: bouncing hand-drawn doodles and soft rising steam capture the funny uncle's loud Friday laughter.

hdn-coffee.rationale: Storybook-light truce world: slow drifting cloud blobs, a breathing warm light and gentle motes give the soft breathing room of a small truce.

sharq-coffee-and-roastery.rationale: Ticket-diner roastery facing east: a warm dawn sun rising from the lower-right with drifting embers and haze — sun and roast rising together.

nakhati-gelato.rationale: Poster-dark marquee: a cinematic spotlight sweep and twinkling city stars sell every scoop as a late-night event.

salve-artisan-gelato.rationale: Storybook-light: a soft warm sun, drifting clouds and lazy light motes turn a scoop into a bright, unhurried morning stroll.

duirrah.rationale: Majlis-heritage: two lantern glows and a shimmering sadu tile band frame the page like a little house with its door open to guests.

cavida-cafe.rationale: Neon-arcade: a pulsing perspective grid, corner neon glows and flickering sparks make the page the one glowing corner in a sleeping city.

ouia-cafe.rationale: Ticket-diner: a warm bottom haze with slow rising steam wisps says take your time, the coffee is never in a hurry.
